blocks.text: Superfluidity fluids ki woh khoobi hai jis mein un ki viscosity zero hoti hai, yani un mein bilkul ragar (friction) nahi hoti. Jis material mein yeh khoobi ho use superfluid kehte hain. Superfluid behte hue apni kinetic energy nahi khota. Laboratory mein kuch material cryogenic temperature (bohat thanda, absolute zero se thora sa oopar) par superfluid ban jate hain.
Superfluids bohat hi tang jagahon mein se bhi bina kisi rukawat ke guzar jate hain. Yeh gravity ke khilaf oopar ki taraf bhi beh sakte hain.
